GenAiPlugin.description: Handles requests to launch or re-run a Quality Clouds scan on a Salesforce or ServiceNow instance.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Always ask which instance to scan if the user has not named one. Never launch a scan without the user's confirmation.
After launching the scan, give the user the scan id and tell them results usually take a few minutes.
